name: cline
description: Autonomous coding agent as an SDK, IDE extension, or CLI assistant.
one_liner: An AI coding assistant, similar to Claude Code, that can be embedded directly in your code editor, run from the command line, or built into your own product via its SDK.
buyer: A software team lead evaluating AI coding assistants who wants one that plugs into their existing IDE workflow.
business_use_cases: A dev tools company embeds its SDK into their own product to add 'AI pair programmer' features without building an agent from scratch.
An agency standardizes its developers on it to keep consistent AI-assisted workflows across projects.
A trainer builds and sells a course on effective agentic coding workflows using it as the reference tool.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'AI coding agent integration' consulting for companies embedding its SDK into their own products
Build and sell a training course on advanced agentic-coding workflows

steal_this: This weekend, embed its SDK into one small internal tool as a proof of concept, and pitch that integration pattern to a product company as a paid feature.
